dataset_name: BHIV vNEXT Normalized Aircraft Observation Dataset
licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0

fields.name: aircraft_hex_id
fields.description: Unique 24-bit ICAO aircraft transponder hexadecimal address normalized to uppercase.

fields.name: callsign
fields.description: Flight identification callsign (whitespace stripped, uppercase).

fields.name: registration
fields.description: Airframe tail registration number (whitespace stripped, uppercase).

fields.name: aircraft_type_icao
fields.description: ICAO 4-character aircraft type designator (e.g. B77L, A20N).

fields.name: squawk_code
fields.description: 4-digit octal Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR) transponder code.

fields.name: emitter_category
fields.description: ADS-B wake-turbulence emitter category.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate rounded to 6 decimal places.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate rounded to 6 decimal places.

fields.name: altitude_baro_ft
fields.description: Barometric pressure altitude in feet (0 if on ground).

fields.name: altitude_geom_ft
fields.description: Geometric altitude in feet above WGS84 ellipsoid.

fields.name: is_on_ground
fields.description: Surface state flag: true if on ground, false if airborne.

fields.name: ground_speed_kts
fields.description: Speed over ground in knots rounded to 1 decimal place.

fields.name: true_track_deg
fields.description: Course over ground in degrees clockwise from true north.

fields.name: vertical_rate_fpm
fields.description: Rate of climb or descent in barometric feet per minute.

fields.name: position_age_seconds
fields.description: Latency in seconds since last position report.

fields.name: last_seen_seconds
fields.description: Latency in seconds since last transmission message received.

fields.name: distance_from_center_nm
fields.description: Great-circle distance from query reference point in nautical miles.

fields.name: bearing_from_center_deg
fields.description: Azimuth bearing angle from query reference point in degrees.

fields.name: signal_rssi_db
fields.description: Received signal strength indicator in dBFS.

fields.name: provenance
fields.description: Lineage object with source system, URL, coordinates, and UTC timestamps.
